source.title: Evidence of action sequence chunking in goal-directed instrumental conditioning and its dependence on the dorsomedial prefrontal cortex

confidence_rationale: Clean lesion design from a highly regarded lab, and uniquely valuable because the lesion group functions as a biological ARC-069-OFF control -- an agent structurally stuck at fine grain. Held to 0.66 by a genuine readout mismatch: outcome-devaluation reads the grain of the action-outcome representation used for goal-directed control, not the grain of a rollout proposal, and ARC-069 is a claim about the latter.
failure_signatures: Sham rats reorganised behaviour at the sequence level while dmPFC-lesioned rats withheld only the terminal response, treating sequence elements as distinct behavioural units -- so coarse grain is not automatic and has a specific neural dependency. If REE's regranularisation were an emergent consequence of training rather than a dedicated substrate, this dissociation should not exist.

The heterogeneous chain is only two presses deep; a result at this depth cannot discriminate 'the system has one optional coarser grain' from 'the system rescales grain continuously', and only the latter is ARC-069.

mapping.source_claim_statement: Rats can use sequence-level representations (action chunks) to organise instrumental behaviour in a goal-directed manner: sham animals withheld a whole sequence when its outcome was devalued or its contingency degraded, whereas dorsomedial-prefrontal-lesioned animals failed to reorganise at the sequence level and instead withheld only the terminal response, indicating they represented the elements as distinct behavioural units.
mapping.ree_translation: The grain at which a policy is represented is a real, dissociable, neurally-dependent variable rather than an artifact of description -- and, critically, the coarse grain is not the default. Removing one structure leaves an otherwise-competent agent permanently operating at element grain. That is the biological instance of ARC-069's own falsifiable prediction: an agent lacking the regranularisation substrate keeps proposing at single-action grain and pays the full cost.
mapping.mapping_caveat: Outcome devaluation probes the units over which OUTCOME VALUE is assigned during instrumental performance. ARC-069 concerns the units the hippocampal proposer (ARC-007) emits into rollout and that the rule-apprehension layer (ARC-062) reads. These are plausibly different representational systems, and ARC-007 is explicitly value-flat -- so a result about value-assignment grain may not transfer to proposal grain at all. This is the single largest weakness in the mapping and the reason confidence sits below the other two ARC-069 entries.
mapping.source_context: Excitotoxic cell-body lesions of dorsomedial prefrontal cortex in rats; concurrent bidirectional heterogeneous chain task with outcome devaluation and contingency degradation tests.

confidence_components.notes: Mapping fidelity is the binding constraint here, not source quality. The value-grain / proposal-grain distinction is not a pedantic one for REE specifically, because ARC-007 proposals are committed to being value-flat.
